issues.on_page: Line 39 Debt Service (Governmental section), Water Well Constr Fund column 5,033.00
issues.issue: printed in the Governmental section of the form but in the Water Well Constr Fund column, so it was treated as business-type (marked review). That is defensible because the fund is funded by Water Fund transfers and the debt is the water loans. Notes call it 'business-type principal' but the category is principal and interest combined; the page doesn't split it.

issues.on_page: line 21 / line 52 utility columns include business-type transfers of 11,098.00 each side
issues.issue: printed business-type totals include the gross 11,098.00 intra-utility transfers. They are recorded in a non-standard 'includes_split' field, and 'includes' is empty. The receipts lines (10,020.35) and disbursements lines (7,917.18) won't tie to reported_totals unless the validator reads includes_split. The amounts themselves are correct.
